                                                             2020 Annual Report 年報
     康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其                      Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and
     附屬公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事                      its subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and
     生產和銷售方便麵及飲品。本集團於1992                    distribution of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s
     年開始生產方便麵，並自1996年起擴大業                    Republic of China (the “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle
     務至方便食品及飲品；2012年3月，本集團                   business in 1992, and expanded into instant food business and
     進一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與PepsiCo                  beverage business in 1996. In March 2012, the Group further
     中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                      expanded its beverage business by forming a strategic alliance
     製造、灌裝、包裝、銷售及分銷PepsiCo於                  with PepsiCo for the beverage business in the PRC. The Company
     中國的非酒精飲料。目前本集團的主要產                      exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages, distributes and sells
     品，皆已在中國食品市場佔有顯著的市場                      PepsiCo soft drinks in the PRC. The Group’s main business segments
     地位。據尼爾森2020年12月數據顯示，以                   have established leading market shares in the PRC’s food industry.
     銷售量為基準，在2020年本集團於方便麵                    According to AC Nielsen December 2020 data, based on sales
     及即飲茶（含奶茶）的市場佔有率分別為                      volume, in 2020, the Group was the market leader in instant
     43.7%及43.6%，穩居市場領導地位；於                  noodles and ready-to-drink teas (incl. milk tea), having gained
     整體果汁的市場佔有率為17.3%，居市場                    43.7% and 43.6% market shares, respectively. In the overall juice
     第二位。據GlobalData 2020年12月數據              drink market, the Group gained 17.3% market share, ranked No.2.
     顯示，百事碳酸飲料2020年銷售量市佔以                    According to GlobalData December 2020 data, based on sales
     33.4%居市場第二位。「康師傅」作為中                    volume, Pepsi carbonated soft drinks had 33.4% market share and
     國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕耘與積                      held a second position. After years of hard work and accumulation,
     累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                         “Master Kong” has become one of the best-known brands among
                                             consumers in the PRC.

     康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                      Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
     引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                      Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
     集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                      and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
     預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                      management system, establishes risk prevention management
     制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                      system, implements entire control over food safety and ensures
     提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                          product quality and safety. We will constantly strive for product
                                             quality and food safety, as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty
                                             and healthy food products.

     本集團不斷完善遍佈全國各地的銷售網                       The Group distributed its products throughout the PRC through
     絡，令新產品更加快速、有效地登陸市                       its extensive sales network consisting of 365 sales offices and 236
     場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                      warehouses serving 47,898 wholesalers and 210,366 direct retailers
     至2020年12月31日，本集團共擁有365個                 as of 31 December 2020. This extensive sales network is a significant
     營業所及236個倉庫以服務47,898家經銷商                 contributor to the Group’s leading market position and it enables
     及210,366家直營零售商。                         the Group to introduce new products rapidly and effectively.

     本公司於1996年2月在香港聯合交易所有限                   The Company was listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong
     公司上市。於2020年12月31日，本公司之                  Limited in February 1996. Market capitalisation as at 31 December
     市值達96億美元。現時本公司為摩根士丹                     2020 was US$9.6 billion. The Company is a constituent stock of
     利資本國際(MSCI)中國指數成份股及恒生中                  Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) China Index and Hang
     國（香港上市）100指數成份股。                        Seng China (Hong Kong-listed) 100 Index.

     今後，本集團仍將發展焦點集中於食品製                      Focused on food manufacture, sales and distribution business, the
     造、行銷及流通行業，並繼續強化通路與                      Group will continue to strengthen its logistics and sales network in
     銷售系統網絡，以建立「全球最大中式方                      the PRC with target of becoming “The largest Group for Chinese

06   康師傅控股有限公司
     TINGYI (CAYMAN ISLANDS) HOLDING CORP.
主席報告
Chairman’s Statement
面 臨 年 初 開 始 的 疫 情 爆 發， 本 集 團 延 續   In spite of the Novel Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) outbreak in
「鞏 固、 革 新、 發 展 」的 經 營 方 針 一 路 前    the beginning of 2020, our Group has pressed ahead by continually
行。除感謝政府部門、社會各界的指導，                 executing the business strategy of “Consolidate, Reform and Develop”.
也感謝我們全體員工在前線風冷血熱的抗                 With the joint efforts from each and every one of our colleagues, our
疫支援，更感謝一路相伴比肩前行的夥伴                 Group managed to realize a smooth and orderly transformation and
與一直支援我們的消費者，在公司全體同                 upgrading, and thus surviving a tough year. We are particularly grateful
仁的共同努力下，在集團企業轉型升級有                 for the support and help from the government, the community, our
序推進的基礎下，共同攜手度過危難艱辛                 partners and customers, and also greatly appreciate the contributions of
的一年。                               our colleagues who went to the front line and played an important part
                                   in the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic.

當前全球疫情肆虐，面對社會環境的快速                 Currently, traditional forms of food and beverage industry are challenged
變遷及科技的加速選代，食品飲料行業的                 and reshaped by the rampant global pandemic, rapidly-changing society
傳統形態面臨衝擊與影響，康師傅「順應                 and swiftly-iterating technologies. Under such a circumstance, Master
行業發展趨勢」的革新，亦不斷思考自身                 Kong “Conforms to the industry trend” to carry out innovations while
在 新 時 代 中 的 定 位。 集 團 積 極 擁 抱 新 技   proactively exploring its positioning in the new era. We have embraced
術，數位化轉型構建敏捷管理，確保我們                 new technologies, promoted digital transformation, and built agile
在激烈競爭中保持優勢；在秉持「弘揚中                 management to maintain our competitive edges. Apart from remaining
華飲食文化」的初心的同時，我們將繼續                 true to the original aspiration of “Promoting Chinese Food & Beverage
以「服務消費者需求」為最高宗旨，在堅守                Culture”, our Group will keep on taking “Catering to Consumer Needs”
品質至上的前提下，以美味創新的產品，                 as the first priority and offering delicious and innovative products under
來滿足大眾對歡樂飲食與美好生活的需                  the “Quality First” principle, so that public demand for a better life
求。「善盡企業社會責任」，推動我們在環                can be met. In addition, we are well determined to “Fulfill Corporate
境、社會和公司治理等領域精益求精、追                 Social Responsibility” and have been trying the utmost to pay back to
求卓越，盡己之能回饋社會。                      the society by striving for higher scores on Environmental, Social, and
                                   Corporate Governance ratings.

我們希冀凝聚所有客戶、員工、合作夥伴                 I sincerely hope that Master Kong will forge ahead hand in hand
及股東的磅礴力量，用專注務實的精神，                 with all the customers, employees, partners and shareholders, and
一起攜手穩步前行，為引領行業「可持續                 remain focused and pragmatic in the pursuit of leading the industry
發展」而努力，將公司打造成具有國際影                 in “sustainable development”, thus ultimately building itself as a
響力的綜合型食品飲料「民族品牌」企業。                comprehensive “Chinese Ethical Brand” of food and beverage with
                                   international influence.

謹借此機會，對董事會同仁、管理層、各                 I would like to take this opportunity to express my heartfelt gratitude
員工及消費者多年的支持致以衷心感謝。                 to all fellow members of the Board, the management team, employees
                                   and customers for their support over the years.

     2020 年 是 不 平 凡 的 一 年， 中 國 在 短 時 間       The year 2020 was an extraordinary one. Over the past year, China
     內有效控制了疫情，經濟發展逐季恢復改                      managed to contain the coronavirus pandemic within a short period
     善， 是 全 球 唯 一 實 現 正 增 長 的 主 要 經 濟        of time and its economy gradually recovered and further developed,
     體。但疫情仍在世界範圍內肆虐，使得全                      standing out as the only major economy worldwide to achieve positive
     球供應鏈受阻，原物料價格上漲，國際貿                      growth. Despite such remarkable achievements, it was also undeniable
     易萎縮。在此等複雜嚴峻的情勢下，整體                      that the year 2020 witnessed the blocked global supply chain, surging
     經濟環境仍承受著較大的壓力與挑戰。                       commodities prices, and shrinking international trade due to the
                                             rampant spread of the COVID-19 pandemic. The overall economic
                                             environment, under such a complicated and serious circumstance, was
                                             posed great pressures and challenges to.

     集團所處的方便麵行業，2020 年上半年，                   Yet the instant noodle industry in the overall market demonstrated

     恢復正常；飲料行業則在上半年受疫情影                      needs for instant noodles increased sharply in the first half of 2020.
     響需求減少後逐步回暖。疫情下的新常態                      It was not until the second half of 2020 that the sales of the instant
     也加速了經營環境的轉型發展，如室內消                      noodle business returned to a normal level and the beverage segment

     改變都為集團帶來了新的挑戰與機遇。                       restructuring of the business environment, manifested by increasing

應對氣候變化                             Tackle Climate Change

康師傅深刻理解氣候變化是全社會                    Master Kong deeply understands that climate change is a
面 臨 的 重 大 挑 戰， 並 認 識 到 積 極 應       major challenge the whole society is facing up, and recognizes
對氣候變化產生的影響是企業長期                    that actively responding to the impact of climate change is the
穩 定 發 展 的 基 礎 和 保 障。 我 們 持 續       foundation and guarantee for the long-term stable development
深 化 對 氣 候 變 化 議 題 的 理 解， 主 動       of the company. We continue to deepen our understanding of
識別自身運營可能受到的氣候變化                    climate change issues, proactively identify the potential impact
潛 在 影 響， 針 對 相 關 氣 候 變 化 風         of climate change on our operations, and actively consider and
險，積極思考和建立應對措施。                     establish response measures for related climate change risks.

受 近 年 來 全 球 氣 候 變 化 的 影 響， 暴       Affected by global climate change in recent years, extreme
雨、 雪 凍 及 颱 風 等 極 端 天 氣 和 自 然       weather and natural disasters such as torrential rain, snow and

生， 干 擾 康 師 傅 工 廠 的 正 常 運 營，        the normal operation of Master Kong’s factory, affecting
影響生產穩定性以至於造成公司財                    production stability and causing the company’s property losses.
產 損 失。 康 師 傅 對 運 營 地 各 類 自 然       Master Kong conducted a comprehensive analysis of the possibility

案》對緊急情況發生時的處理措施和                   standardized the handling measures and response methods when
應 對 方 式 進 行 規 範， 並 定 期 組 織 培       emergency situations occurred. Master Kong also organized
訓、 演 練， 同 時 將 極 端 天 氣 納 入 保        training and drills on a regular basis, included the extreme

產提供保障。                             and provided guarantees for company’s assets.

在 原 材 料 供 給 方 面， 極 端 天 氣 可 能       In terms of raw material supply, extreme weather may cause a
造 成 農 產 品 產 量 下 降， 從 而 引 發 公       decline in the output of agricultural products, which triggers price
司 生 產 原 料 的 價 格 波 動， 影 響 生 產       fluctuations of the company’s raw materials and affect production
成 本。 康 師 傅 積 極 開 展 原 物 料 價 格       costs. Master Kong actively carries out raw material price analysis,

合 同 提 前 鎖 定 原 物 料 價 格， 控 制 生       advance to control production costs. In addition, extreme weather
產 成 本。 另 外， 極 端 天 氣 同 樣 可 能        may also have a short-term impact on the normal transportation

響。 康 師 傅 生 產 需 求 的 各 種 原 物 料       Kong’s production are widely produced in mainland China

          人力資源數字化管理


在發展迅速且多變的市場環境中，企業必須提高運營效率，以應對變化和挑戰。本年度，憑藉數字化「無界
共享賦能康師傅 HR 數字化轉型項目」，康師傅斬獲 IDC「未來工作領軍者」數字化轉型大獎。


康師傅完成了薪酬全面外包服務，將 HR 從事務性工作中解放出來，聚焦人力資源戰略和增值服務。更全方位
加速了康師傅的人力資源數字化轉型，全面助力升級了康師傅的管理運營體系。


為更好促進 HR 工作效率，提升員工體驗，我們搭建了人力資源智能系統，該系統集 BI 報表、管理駕駛艙、
自助分析為一體，打通了人資、財務、銷售等多個數據源，建立了適合智能分析和展現的數據模型，實現數
據視圖管理、多維報表設計、智能分析報告設計、管理者駕駛艙等功能，透過移動端實時展示數據。為提升
新員工體驗，實現生產、管理、協作、運營的移動化，我們上線預入職小程序，為新進員工、部門主管、人
資之間搭建一個快速、低成本、高質量的移動應用平台。此外，為精進人事工作流程，簡化操作，我們推進
人事工作流運作，使員工合同、檔案管理等集中在 OA（Office Automation，辦公自動化）平台上進行。


Digital-based HR Management


In a rapidly evolving and volatile market environment, enterprises are required to improve operational efficiency to
cope with changes and challenges. In this year, Master Kong was granted the IDC digital transformation award of
“Future Work Leaders” for its “Boundless Sharing Empowers HR Digital Transformation Project of Master Kong”.

Master Kong has used the complete salary outsourcing service, which liberates HR from transactional work, so
that they could focus on human resource strategy and value-added services. Hence, it has accelerated our digital
HR transformation in an all-round way, and comprehensively helped upgrade our management and operation
system.

In order to better promote HR work efficiency and enhance employee experience, we have built an intelligent
HR system which integrates BI reporting, management cockpit and self-service analysis, opens up multiple data
sources such as human resources, finance, and sales, establishes a data model suitable for intelligent analysis and
presentation, realizes data view management, multi-dimensional report design, intelligent analysis report design,
management cockpit and other functions as well as real-time display of data through the mobile terminal. With
a view to enhance the experience of new employees and realize the mobilization of production, management,
collaboration, and operations, we launched a pre-employment mini program to build a fast, low-cost, and high-
quality mobile application platform for new employees, department heads, and human resources. In addition, in
order to streamline the personnel workflow and operation, we promote the operation of the personnel workflow,
so that employee contracts and file management are centralized on the OA (Office Automation) platform.

風險管理及內部監控                             RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL

本集團所建立的內部監控及風險管理程式                    The principal spirit of the internal control and risk management
的主要精神係遵循 COSO 架構五元素，分                 procedures established by the Group is in compliance with five elements
別是監控環境、風險評估、監控、資訊及                    in the COSO structure, i.e. control environment, risk assessment,
溝通、監察評估。風險管理目標是將集團                    control activities, information and communication, and monitoring.
整體風險控制在可接受的水準以內，奠定                    The goal of risk management is to keep the overall risk of the Group
集團長遠發展的良好基礎，同時能達到管                    within acceptable levels and to lay a good foundation for the Group’s
理架構及權限明確化以提升營運績效達成                    long- term development. Meanwhile, it can achieve the goal of
及運作效率、保障資產安全，確保財務報                    defining the management structure and authorization so as to enhance
告可靠性，符合國家法規要求等目標。                     the operational performance and efficiency as well as asset safety
                                      protection, which ensures the reliability of financial reports while
                                      complies with the requirements of national regulations.

     在董事會監督下，本集團已建立風險管理                      Under the supervision of the Board, the Group has established an

     12 月 31 日， 本 集團 持 續 推 動 內 控 自 評，        the risk management and internal control system of the Group. As of
     建 立 嚴 謹 而 有 效 的 自 查 自 檢 體 系， 實 現        31 December 2020, the Group has been carrying out self-assessment
     管理循環別自評全覆蓋。同時，持續擴大                      of internal control where a prudent and effective self-inspection
     子公司監理作業，優先針對高風險流程制                      system has been established to achieve full coverage of external and
     定管理規範，同時依照產業競爭態勢及營                      internal inspection on each aspect thought the management circle.
     運需求，擬定精簡而能落地的支出核決權                      Meanwhile, more efforts have been put in supervision over subsidiaries

     監控等工作。根據稽核部門之內部審計，                      to processes of higher risk and streamlined and implementable limits

     本集團所建構的風險管理體系，以「追求                      The risk management system established by the Group sets “pursuing
     永續發展，承擔社會責任」為管理目標，                      sustainable development and assuming social responsibility” as
     管理流程包含：風險識別、風險評估及評                      management objective. The management process includes risk
     價、風險控制和全面監控等環節。首先，                      identification, risk assessment and evaluation, risk control and overall
     透過系統性、科學化的方法執行風險管理                      monitoring. Firstly, the implementation of risk management objectives is
     目標的設定。然後，經由與經營階層訪談                      set through systematic and scientific methods. Then, through interviews
     及風險研討會之舉行，完成風險識別並確                      with management and risk seminars, risk identification and risk
     認風險管理框架。第三，經由高階領導充                      management framework are completed. Thirdly, fully participate in the
     分參與討論完成風險評估，進而擬定風險                      discussion through senior management to complete the risk assessment,
     應對策略。最後，持續執行風險控制活動                      and then formulate risk response strategies. Finally, continue to
     及監督。                                    implement risk control activities and supervision.

     在擬定風險應對策略後，將透過定期追蹤                      We will ensure the effective implementation of risk management
     與 覆 核， 確 保 風 險 管 理 措 施 得 以 有 效 實        measure through periodic tracking and review after formulation of risk

      平衡。本公司的股息政策旨在讓股東得以                      a sustainable dividend policy. The Company’s dividend policy aims
      分享本公司的利潤，同時讓本公司預留足                      to allow shareholders to participate in the Company’s profit and for
      夠儲備金供日後發展之用。在建議宣佈及                      the Company to retain adequate reserves for future development.
      派付股息時，本公司會考慮多項因素：包                      In proposing any dividend payout, the Company would consider
      括本集團的實際和預期財務業績、本集團                      various factors including the Group’s actual and expected financial
      的流動資金水準及未來發展計劃、整體經                      performance, the Group’s liquidity levels and future development plans,
      濟及金融狀況、本集團的商業週期、可能                      general economic and financial conditions, business cycle of the Group,
      對本集團業務或財務業績和狀況有影響的                      internal or external factors that may have an impact on the business or
      內在或外在因素，及董事會認為相關的其                      financial performance of the Group, and other factors that the Board
      他因素。                                    considers relevant.

      關鍵審計事項                                  Key Audit Matter

      對杭州百事可樂飲料有限公司（「杭州百事                     Control over Hangzhou Pepsi-cola Beverage Co., Ltd (“HZPS”) and
      可樂」）擁有控制權及商譽減值之評估                       impairment assessment of goodwill

      於 2017 年， 貴 集 團 通 過 執 行 買 賣 協 議         HZPS became a non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Group through an
      （「買 賣 協 議 」）和 一 份 授 權 書 令 杭 州 百 事       execution of sale and purchase agreement (the “SPA”) and a contractual
      可樂成為了         貴集團的非全資擁有附屬               arrangement in 2017. The Group currently holds 50% equity interest in
      公司。      貴集團現時於杭州百事可樂持有                 HZPS and has a majority of the voting rights of HZPS.
      50% 股權及過半投票權。

      合併杭州百事可樂需要重大的判斷和估                       The consolidation of HZPS required a significant amount of judgement
      計， 包 括 釐 定 杭 州 百 事 可 樂 的 擁 有 權。         and estimations, including the determination of control over HZPS. At
      於結算日， 貴集團重新評估是否有任何                      the end of the reporting period, the Group re-assessed whether any
      事實和情況顯示其對杭州百事可樂的擁有                      facts and circumstances indicate there are changes of its control over
      權 產 生 變 化。 根 據 重 估 結 果， 管 理 層 總         HZPS. Based on the results of the re-assessment, the management
      結   貴集團擁有杭州百事可樂的控制權；                    concluded that the Group has power over HZPS; has exposure to
      須面對可變回報及有能力透過其權力影                       variable returns from its involvement with HZPS; and has the ability to
      響 這 些 回 報。 因 此， 杭 州 百 事 可 樂 繼 續         use its power over HZPS to affect its returns. Therefore, the financial
      在   貴集團截至 2020 年 12 月 31 日止年度           statements of HZPS continue to be consolidated in the Group’s
      的綜合財務報表中合併入賬。                           consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December
                                              2020.

      年度減值測試，商譽已分配至關連現金產                      The goodwill was allocated to related CGU, and the recoverable
      生單位，而現金產生單位的可收回金額將                      amount of CGU will be determined by management based on value
      由管理層根據使用現金流量預測計算的使                      in use calculation using cash flow projection. The calculations involved

           權 益 的 比 率 ）以 監 察 其 資 本（包 括 所                   equivalents) as a ratio of the equity attributable to owners of the
           有權益部分）。報告期末債務權益比                               Company. The debt-to-equity ratio at the end of the reporting
